item.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Skylight Workspace Config Service Local Privilege Escalation (CVE-2026-7791)

Affected Target

Field Value
Software / System Amazon WorkSpaces — Skylight Workspace Config Service
Versions Affected Skylight prior to 2.6.2034.0
Language / Platform Windows (Amazon WorkSpaces client image)
Authentication Required Yes (low-privileged/standard WorkSpaces user)
Network Access Required No (local privilege escalation)

Summary

The Skylight Workspace Config Service on Amazon WorkSpaces runs as SYSTEM and performs scheduled log rotation under C:\ProgramData\Amazon. Permissive ACLs on this directory, a ROTATE directory junction, absence of file-type checks, and a ~1-10 ms TOCTOU window between the service’s first file-move operation and its enumeration of archived files allow a low-privileged standard user to redirect the SYSTEM-level file-move operation to an arbitrary attacker-controlled destination, achieving arbitrary file write as SYSTEM and ultimately local privilege escalation.
